$comment: The base images a release builds from, by digest (SEC-D-04, ADR-SEC-05). release-publish.yml pulls exactly these and refuses a tag that has moved, so a base re-pushed on Docker Hub cannot reach a release unseen. Moving a base is a reviewed change to this file (CODEOWNERS). Update with: crane digest pipeshubai/pipeshub-ai-base:<tag>; scripts/supply_chain.py check requires every entry to be a 64-hex sha256.
